notes.title: Patch Notes - Demo.4576.822
notes.content:
Heya Collectors!

We have another smaller patch ready for you all!

Fixes
 Fixed an issue that would cause island save data to not be completely deleted when starting a new trip while an island was active
 This issue led to some objects being placed in wrong spots on affected islands (e.g. Rune Stones)
 Fixed special conditions for Fabled Clownfish and Fabled Butterflyfish not considering decorations placed in the boat interior
 Fixed gamepad navigation in chest menu not navigating to player inventory under certain circumstances
 Fixed player companion missing sleep vfx on islands
 Fixed Player Guide Secret Seller page translations for German, Spanish and Japanese to more accurately reflect how it works

notes.title: Patch Notes - Demo.4562.817
notes.content:
Hello Collectors!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983255/4662a991bff27785cdd17ba8eaf0dc5a202fa880.png

Here is our first patch for the demo with several critical fixes and adjustments!

Fixes
Fixed an issue that could softlock the game in an infinite loading screen when going inside the boat while an island was being generated
Fixed an issue that could softlock the game when opening the compendium through the discovery popup during certain activities (fishing, building, flotsam)
Fixed flickering water on certain GPUs
If you still experience issues with the water, please let us know!
Fixed a bridge not being walkable on one specific island in a very specific configuration
Fixed some drag drop operations working even when used on disabled inventory slots
Fixed fish spawn times not being displayed correctly when cycling through fish in compendium
Updated French translation for Fabled Clownfish special condition to more accurately reflect the condition
Changes
Changed treasure puzzle runes to glow by default and stop glowing when activated in an attempt to improve readability
Changed tiki statue rune for resources to improve readability

notes.title: Collector's Cove DEMO is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Ahoy, Collectors! The day has come!!


We're incredibly excited to share that the first-ever demo of Collector’s Cove is now live!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983255/4662a991bff27785cdd17ba8eaf0dc5a202fa880.png"]

And even better: it’s launching as part of the Wholesome Direct 2025!
We couldn’t dream of a better occasion to welcome you aboard for your first cozy journey in Collector's Cove! 

New trailer just dropped!

[previewyoutube="203iLkvIwdk;full"][/previewyoutube]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983255/434c31cdcd90d39470da6e1e53a8d9c8807d7f9f.png"]What can you do in the demo?
 Explore the first climate zone, with its own islands, flora & treasures

 Upgrade and personalize your boat with cozy decorations

 Fishing, farming and foraging

 Bond with your animal companion and customize them

 Begin filling out your Collector’s Compendium with all your discoveries


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983255/9329d354e4f13609293d45e7b39aa4f5e17574c6.gif"]


Soak in the sounds of the sea and begin gathering fabled fish & crops to catalog your cozy journey, all at your own pace. There's no rush! Just peace and quiet as you discover this new world and its small joys along the way.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983255/f14829bad6dd044cf93c774fe28b4b7fbea7e396.png"]
Updated store page!

We’ve also just updated our store page with a brand-new trailer, screenshots, and GIFs, all showcasing the latest additions, visual improvements and updated UI we’ve been working on! 🌟
Take a look for a fresh peek at how life is going to be aboard your homey floating farm!!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2867470/Collectors_Cove/"][/dynamiclink] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983255/19c40a67c8ac271ab66654187d885d3568c1df48.png"]
We’d love your thoughts

If you play the demo, we’d truly appreciate it if you took a moment to share your thoughts with us; there are plenty of ways to do so!


Our Discord! This is where the team is the most present and reactive.

Our Steam community forum.

By tagging us on our socials, either on Twitter / X or Bluesky!

Your feedback helps us make Collector’s Cove the best it can be.

Thank you for sailing with us. We hope this first taste of Collector’s Cove brings you some warmth and joy 🧡

notes.title: Join the next Collector's Cove Playtest!
notes.content:
Ahoy, Collectors!

To keep it short: our second closed playtest is coming! And you can sign up right now!

All relevant info can be found in this blogpost, so keep on readin' :D

We’re beyond excited to announce that we’re opening the doors for a second Closed Playtest! After receiving an incredible amount of helpful feedback from our first test, we’re ready to welcome a new wave of players to experience the next stage of Collector’s Cove development.

Come unwind in our cozy farming haven—where you can set sail with your loyal animal companion by your side and farm, fish, island-hop and drift across the seas to complete your Collector's Compendium!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983255/f14829bad6dd044cf93c774fe28b4b7fbea7e396.png

WANT TO JOIN? HERE'S HOW  ⬇

You can register for our next Collector's Cove playtest starting today! Registration will remain open until we have all the participants we need. 
The playtest itself will start soon this month (April 2025) and is expected to last about a week.

Spots are limited, so signing up gives you a chance to participate—but not everyone will be selected.

Since we're a small team, we want to ensure we can give every participant the attention they deserve. That means spots are limited—we want to read all your feedback, engage with you, and make meaningful improvements based on your experiences.

While registering doesn’t guarantee a spot, don’t worry! This is just one of many chances to be part of Collector’s Cove’s journey!

Click the link below to fill out our sign-up survey:

SIGN UP HERE!

In order to make the process as smooth and valuable as possible, please answer as accurately as you can.

IMPORTANT: Joining our Discord is essential for participating, as that’s where you’ll receive access and updates about the playtest, share feedback, and chat with the devs!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983255/daabc031a079eecc5b92405899e1943490e9a421.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983255/19c40a67c8ac271ab66654187d885d3568c1df48.png

WHAT'S NEW THIS TIME?

Since our last playtest, we’ve made several improvements and adjustments based on player feedback. This means you’ll get to experience a more polished version of the game, with various tweaks, additions, and refinements! Your insights continue to be invaluable in shaping Collector’s Cove into the best adventure it can be.

Please keep in mind that this version is still a work in progress, and your feedback will help us smooth out rough edges and make meaningful improvements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983255/f532e39d0417a61f7fb7b1b5daa229bb872760fe.png

BECOME A COLLECTOR!

If you want to stay updated on all things Collector’s Cove, be sure to follow us on Twitter & Bluesky, where we share sneak peeks, updates, and all useful announcements!

We also have a community Discord for all the Collectors at heart out there!
You're welcome to join to share, talk, and even discover some fun facts about the crops & fish we have in Collector's Cove! 🌾 🐠

Take care of yourself and of each other, Collectors, and see you next time! ♡

notes.title: Register to our first Playtest!
notes.content:
Welcome to all Collector’s Cove and cozy game enthusiasts!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983255/4662a991bff27785cdd17ba8eaf0dc5a202fa880.png

We’re thrilled to share that Collector’s Cove has reached a stage where your valuable feedback can help shape its development!
Soon, we will be holding our first Closed Playtest!
Registration opens TODAY for this exclusive test, set to take place later this January. If you’re interested and think you’ll be able to participate and provide feedback, check out the registration details below ⬇

As the game is still deep in development, access will be limited to a small number of players for this initial test. While filling out the form doesn’t guarantee a spot, rest assured that this is just the beginning of many more opportunities to be part of Collector’s Cove’s journey!

We’ve been hard at work crafting the best cozy farming adventure, where you can cultivate rare crops, reel in elusive fish, uncover island secrets, and relax in the cozy solitude of your oceanic home.

This Closed Playtest is designed to refine the game’s core mechanics and gather your feedback to help us deliver the best possible experience for the full release.

Your support means the world to us, and we can’t wait for you to embark on this journey with us!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983255/b148fff84949dc77458a3dbcab8f5e89010cc860.png

HOW DO I REGISTER?

You can register for our first Collector's Cove playtest starting today! Registration will remain open until we have all the participants we need. 

The playtest itself is expected to last about a week, giving you an early glimpse into the cozy adventure that awaits. Don’t miss this chance to help shape the game!
For this, you simply need to fill out the form below by clicking on the link:

CLOSED PLAYTEST SIGN-UP SURVEY

In order to make the process as smooth and valuable as possible, please answer as accurately as you can.

Make sure you also join our Discord, as it is essential to participate in this playtest! It’s the hub for all playtest updates, and also where you’ll share your feedback and engage in discussions directly with the devs!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983255/c5e9fcf5032f5d584aed9ba3dfb80c0658a3bfe2.png

Please keep in mind that the content for our Closed Playtest represents an early version of Collector’s Cove and is still a work in progress. This playtest is an important step for us to gather your feedback and make improvements as we work toward creating the best possible experience for the full release!

Thank you for signing up - we can’t wait for you to get a taste of Collector’s Cove!
You’ll get informed if you are selected once we’ve started the Closed Playtest process.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983255/19c40a67c8ac271ab66654187d885d3568c1df48.png

STAY IN TOUCH!

If you want to stay up to date with the latest news & announcements or simply see more content around Collector’s Cove, you can follow us on our Twitter & Bluesky pages!

We also have a Discord that's under construction 🚧 !
You're welcome to join to share, talk & have a good time.

You will be received with much love and warmth!

Take care and until next time, Collectors ♡
